description: Updatr catalog: hold rules for version-sensitive packages.

items.description: Packages to leave alone during "upgrade all".

pattern.description: Package id wildcard: * matches any run of characters, ? one character. Case-insensitive.

source.description: Source the pattern applies to (winget, npm, ...). Defaults to winget.

group.description: Grouping shown in the UI, e.g. "Databases".

reason.description: Why this is held - shown to the user.

behavior.description: hold (default), storeManaged, or explicit (self-updating: only upgraded when named).

$schema.description: Editor hint pointing at this file's JSON schema. Ignored by Updatr.

schemaVersion.description: Catalog schema version. Updatr ignores a catalog newer than it understands and falls back to its cached or built-in copy.
